4866.title: Windows stop rejects before delayed exit notification
4866.rootCauseOneLine: Windows stopping equates pending exit notification with a live root; both clean modeled runs reject an already absent root PID.
4866.proposedFix: Confirm the state in the shipped native Windows runtime, then consistently recognize definitive root termination without overstating descendant cleanup.
4866.caveats: Both runs are Linux models of delayed Windows notification, not a native Windows/Electron reproduction. Complete test is inline; local artifacts are not published. No automatic fix PR meets the native reproduction gate.
